description: Recovered fx2-cmix GCC build with FX2_STRUCT_SIDECAR=3. Adds the same decoder-recomputable FSL/OGI sidecar as the broad candidate, but only injects narrow structural bits into wordscxt, mx17, and mxx mixer contexts.

build.packaging: cmix and english.dic are xz-packed and unpacked by program.py; both count toward local driver program_size.

notes: Narrow ablation after broad FX2_STRUCT_SIDECAR=1 fragmented too many mixer contexts and lost at the 64 KiB screen.
verdict: Reject. Narrow structural sidecar mutation reduced the damage versus broad mode but still lost archive bytes at the 64 KiB screen.
